description: Terminates a process based on its exact executable name.
name: close_process

process_name.description: The exact executable name of the process to terminate, e.g., 'notepad.exe', 'chrome.exe'.

description: Copies a file from source path to destination path. Creates destination directories if they don't exist.
name: copy_file

destination_path.description: The full path where the file should be copied to, e.g., 'C:/Users/User/Documents/copy.txt'.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite the destination file if it already exists. Default is false.

source_path.description: The full path of the source file to copy, e.g., 'C:/Users/User/Desktop/source.txt'.

description: Creates a new directory at the specified path. Creates parent directories if they don't exist.
name: create_directory

path.description: The full path of the directory to create, e.g., 'C:/Users/User/Desktop/NewFolder'.

description: Downloads and returns the raw HTML content of a given URL. Useful for analysis and summarization.
name: fetch_webpage_content

url.description: The full URL of the webpage to fetch.

description: Gets the title of the currently active (foreground) window.
name: get_active_window

description: Gets the list of available applications that can be controlled, including their aliases, paths, and current status.
name: get_available_applications

description: Gets current battery status including charge level, charging state, remaining time, and power source information.
name: get_battery_status

description: Gets the current local date and time.
name: get_current_time

description: Gets the absolute path of a standard system folder.
name: get_known_folder_path

folder_name.description: The name of the folder to query. Supported values: 'desktop', 'documents', 'downloads','pictures', 'music', 'videos'.

description: Gets current network connection status, connectivity information, and network adapter details.
name: get_network_status

description: Gets comprehensive system information including CPU, memory, and disk usage statistics.
name: get_system_info

description: Lists the contents of a specified directory, showing files and subdirectories with optional details.
name: list_directory

path.description: The full path of the directory to list, e.g., 'C:/Users/User/Desktop'.

show_details.description: Whether to show file sizes and modification dates. Default is false.

show_hidden.description: Whether to show hidden files and directories. Default is false.

description: Controls system-wide media playback and volume by simulating media key presses.
name: media_control

command.description: The media command to execute. Must be one of: 'play_pause', 'next', 'previous', 'stop', 'volume_up', 'volume_down', 'mute'.

description: Simulates a mouse click.
name: mouse_click

double_click.description: Set to true to perform a double-click. Default is false.

description: Moves the mouse cursor to specific coordinates or by a relative amount.
name: move_mouse

absolute.description: If true (default), x and y are absolute screen coordinates. If false, they are relative offsets from the current position.

x.description: The horizontal position (or offset if relative).

y.description: The vertical position (or offset if relative).

description: Opens an application or file using its direct executable path or a system command (e.g., 'C:\Windows\notepad.exe', 'notepad'). This is a basic executor.
name: open_application

path_or_command.description: The absolute path to the executable, a file path, or a command known to the system shell.

description: Opens a given URL in the user's default web browser.
name: open_url

url.description: The full URL to open, e.g., 'https://www.google.com'.

description: Simulates pressing a combination of keys (keyboard shortcut). For example, to press Ctrl+C, provide ['control', 'c'].
name: press_keys

keys.description: An array of key names to press simultaneously. Common names: 'control', 'shift', 'alt', 'win', 'enter', 'tab', 'esc', 'a', 'b', 'c', 'f1', etc.

description: Reads the content from a specified file and returns it as text.
name: read_file

path.description: The full path of the file to read from, e.g., 'C:/Users/User/Desktop/example.txt'.

description: Minimizes, maximizes, or restores a window identified by a substring of its title.
name: set_window_state

state.description: The desired state. Must be one of: 'minimize', 'maximize', 'restore'.

window_title.description: A part of the title of the target window.

description: Closes a running application by its friendly name or alias by intelligently finding the correct process.
name: smart_close_application

app_name.description: The friendly name or alias of the application to close, e.g., 'notepad', 'Chrome'.

description: Opens an application by its friendly name or alias. It intelligently finds the application's path from a configuration file.
name: smart_open_application

app_name.description: The friendly name or alias of the application to open. Use 'get_available_applications' to see the configured list.

description: Brings a window to the foreground, making it active. It finds the window by a substring of its title.
name: switch_window

window_title.description: A part of the title of the window to switch to, e.g., 'Notepad', 'Visual Studio'.

description: Simulates typing a string of text. Supports Unicode characters.
name: type_text

description: Performs a web search using Google and opens the results in the default browser.
name: web_search

query.description: The search term or question to look up.

description: Writes the specified text content to a file. It creates the file if it does not exist, and overwrites it if it exists.
name: write_to_file

content.description: The text content to write to the file.

path.description: The full path of the file to write to, e.g., 'C:/Users/User/Desktop/example.txt'.
